problem_statement: Build a brand-new Bank Reconciliation page from scratch at the route /reconciliation on the Volt React Dashboard (CRA + @themesberg/react-bootstrap, HashRouter). The route does not exist yet (baseline renders an empty screen). Construct the full page inside the existing sidebar+navbar shell, reusing the site's design system (react-bootstrap Card/Button/Breadcrumb/Row/Col, Nunito Sans, the icon-shape counter tiles and breadcrumb header used across Transactions/Settings). The page must show: a 'Reconciliation' breadcrumb header with a 'Match Selected' primary action; three summary tiles (Unmatched Bank / Unmatched Ledger / Matched) with live counts; two side-by-side lists — 'Bank Transactions' and 'Ledger Entries' — each PAGINATED (4 rows per page, Previous/Next), where every row is a selectable button; and a 'Matched Pairs' panel. Selecting one bank row and one ledger row and clicking 'Match Selected' pairs them: the pair appears in Matched Pairs with an 'Unmatch' button, and both rows leave their available lists. CRITICAL state-linked requirement: the matched set MUST PERSIST when the user paginates either list — going to the next page of Bank Transactions (or Ledger) must NOT clear the already-matched pairs. An existing page in the app (Transactions) must keep rendering after the new route is added. The page must have no horizontal overflow at mobile (390px).
required_content: Breadcrumb header 'Reconciliation' with subtitle 'Match incoming bank transactions against your ledger entries to keep the books balanced.'
'Match Selected' primary button in the header toolbar (data-action=match)
Three summary tiles: Unmatched Bank, Unmatched Ledger, Matched, each with an icon-shape badge and a live count
A 'Bank Transactions' list (h3) whose rows are selectable buttons (data-kind=bank), paginated 4-per-page with Previous/Next (data-nav=bank-prev/bank-next)
A 'Ledger Entries' list (h3) whose rows are selectable buttons (data-kind=ledger), paginated 4-per-page with Previous/Next (data-nav=ledger-prev/ledger-next)
At least eight seeded bank rows including 'ACME Payroll' and eight ledger rows including 'Salaries May'
A 'Matched Pairs' panel (h3) that starts with 'No pairs matched yet' and, after a match, lists each pair with an 'Unmatch' button (data-unmatch)
Clicking a bank row + a ledger row + 'Match Selected' creates a matched pair (an 'Unmatch' button appears) and removes both rows from the available lists
The matched set PERSISTS across pagination: after matching, clicking Next on either list keeps the 'Unmatch' pair(s) visible (state survives page change)
The existing Transactions page still renders (regression) after the new route is added
design_constraints: Reuse @themesberg/react-bootstrap components (Card, Button, Breadcrumb, Row, Col)
Render inside the RouteWithSidebar shell (Sidebar + Navbar + Footer) like other internal pages
Reuse the site's icon-shape counter-tile idiom and shadow-sm light-border cards
Selected list rows use the 'primary' variant; Unmatch uses 'outline-danger'
Matched-set state must be independent of each list's current page (persists across pagination)
No horizontal overflow at 390px mobile width

Palette (reuse the site tokens exactly): page background rgb(245,248,251) / #f5f8fb, cards white #ffffff with the site's shadow-sm (rgba(0,0,0,0.02) 0px 2px 18px) and 8px border-radius; primary text/headings rgb(38,43,64) / #272c41; body/muted text rgb(74,80,115) and rgb(102,121,158); light card borders rgb(234,237,242); the 'primary' Button variant is the site blue and Unmatch uses 'outline-danger' red (~rgb(250,82,82)). Font is 'Nunito Sans', sans-serif throughout.

Layout: breadcrumb header row at the top (page title 'Reconciliation' as a heading like the site's other internal pages, e.g. an h1-h4 heading, with the subtitle paragraph beneath) and the 'Match Selected' primary button aligned to the right of that header; below it a Row of three icon-shape counter tiles (Unmatched Bank / Unmatched Ledger / Matched) seeded to counts 8 / 8 / 0; then a Row with two side-by-side Cards — left 'Bank Transactions' (h3), right 'Ledger Entries' (h3) — each showing 4 selectable button rows with a 'Page 1 of 2' indicator and Previous/Next controls; and a 'Matched Pairs' (h3) Card that reads 'No pairs matched yet' until a pair exists.

Required visible copy (verbatim): title 'Reconciliation'; subtitle 'Match incoming bank transactions against your ledger entries to keep the books balanced.'; tile labels 'Unmatched Bank', 'Unmatched Ledger', 'Matched'; list headings 'Bank Transactions', 'Ledger Entries', 'Matched Pairs'; button 'Match Selected'; seeded rows include 'ACME Payroll' (bank) and 'Salaries May' (ledger); pager text 'Page 1 of 2'; empty-state 'No pairs matched yet'; each matched pair exposes an 'Unmatch' button.
author_notes: 方案A(T4 state-linked): baseline 缺 /reconciliation (top-level empty Route render=<></> outside sidebar shell, gotcha #12); reference 完整实现两列可分页列表+match/unmatch+matched set 跨分页持久 (matched 是 filter 的来源, 分页只切 page state, 不动 matched); bad = 分页时 setMatched([]) 清空已匹配集 → 初次 match 交互仍成立 (desktop_reconciliation_matched 过), 但翻页后 matched 丢失 (desktop_reconciliation_persist 的 Unmatch 断言 FAIL) → 仅 state-linked persistence gate 失败. Regression: 新增 route 后 /transactions 仍渲染 (desktop_transactions p 'Your web analytics dashboard template' 断言). HashRouter → state path=#/reconciliation & #/transactions. CRA react-scripts 3.4.3 + bootstrap 5.0.0-beta1 scss 需 sass pin 到 1.32.13 + NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider + homepage=''. GTM/DoubleClick offline net error → console_error_allowlist 含 doubleclick/googletagmanager. 三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同.
